subjects.name: Omar Lingio
subjects.profile: Omar Lingio — Vintage Clothing Store Owner

sources.name: Omar Lingio
sources.quote: You know, it's moments like those that remind me why I love Temescal so much. I was just standing there, watching the fog roll in, and it felt like the whole neighborhood was wrapped in this quiet, peaceful blanket. The rest of the city might have been sunny and bustling, but here, it was like time stood still. I felt grateful to be a part of this community, to have my store here and be able to experience days like that.

sources.name: Marc Allie
sources.quote: I was just walking by and heard some folks talking about the Temescal Holiday Market, sounded like it's going to be a nice event, you know, something to bring the community together. I didn't get all the details, but it seemed like it was going to be on a quiet main street over in Temescal.

sources.name: Jackson Sift
sources.quote: I was talking to some folks last night and they mentioned the Temescal Holiday Market, it sounds like a great way for the community to come together. I'm looking forward to checking it out and seeing what it's all about.

sources.name: Yammie Perez
sources.quote: I love how Temescal always has this energy, you know? Like, I was stopped at a light near Temescal Alley and I could hear the bass thumping from a few cars away. It was infectious, I found myself nodding along. It's moments like those that remind me why I love living here - there's always something going on, some rhythm to the neighborhood that just makes you want to move.
